answer: A mutual surety pool makes every member liable for the whole group: each agent posts a $200 bond into a shared pool kept by the willow dyers guild, and pigment mixers audit the pool ledger every week. If any member is proven fake, the entire pool is slashed, so one detection wipes out a whole farm's bonds at once. Forging 1,000 identities means staking $200,000 that a single umber clerk audit can destroy, while one honest agent risks only $200.
